classification.difficultyReason: Recognise two hidden contact squares at each join of three supplied cubes and the explicitly excluded largest base, then subtract from familiar cube face totals. Requires choosing exposed surfaces in a supplied composite, with no proof or unsupplied modelling.

content.prompt: A modern sculpture consists of three cubes, with side lengths $0.5\text{ m}$, $1\text{ m}$ and $1.5\text{ m}$, respectively, placed on top of each other as shown in the diagram opposite. Calculate the surface area of the sculpture. Do not include the base of the large cube in your calculations.

spec.description: Three cubes stacked largest to smallest, with their rear-left corners aligned. Ordinary source blue edges and red dashed hidden edges are rendered in house black; dashes retain hidden-edge meaning. No shading or dimension labels.
spec.mathematics: Cube side lengths are in the ratio 3:2:1. The middle cube rests completely on the largest cube, and the smallest rests completely on the middle cube. Each contact hides two congruent square regions.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied solid is visible; no calculated areas or answers are included.

sizing.exceptionReason: Reviewed narrow/tall source solid: retain proportional geometry, all dimensions and native 10 pt labels. Height above the ordinary 40 mm review trigger may be necessary for distinguishable marks; working space is unchanged.

answer.short:
$16.25\text{ m}^2$

Exclude both touching faces at each join and the base of the largest cube.
answer.worked:
The two joins hide two squares of side $1\text{ m}$ and two squares of side $0.5\text{ m}$. Also exclude the base of the largest cube.

$$\begin{align*}S&=6(1.5^2+1^2+0.5^2)-2(1^2)-2(0.5^2)-1.5^2\\S&=21-2-0.5-2.25\\S&=16.25\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$
